Close 2026-09-05: the day record, SDUI §112, and the 09-06 agenda (#248)

The morning block already covered #240-#242. This adds the day's second
half, which was entirely Mukesh looking at the site and finding things
nothing we own could have caught - #243 through #247.

SDUI 112 is the part that needed care, because unlike the last two days
this one is NOT iOS-zero. Four native files changed and none is a
comment: the PayLogoGrabpay bundled asset, plus PaymentBrandLogos,
SDUIAcceptedPayments and SDUIPaymentMethodPicker. All four need a build.
The section carries a real port-diff for the new framing rule - which
marks are self-framed, who picks the wrapper, and the kit-card height -
with each row noting that payment-logo-parity.test.ts pins the two
platforms equal.

The parked item is stated plainly rather than folded into a summary
line: the ad-hoc IPA is current (adhoc-latest is built from 12309631 and
nothing iOS landed after it), but App Store users are on 1.0.5 and still
see the broken "Grao" glyph and the double-framed chips. Not a
regression - the glyph predates today by five months - but not fixed for
them either. Fold into the next submission; do not fire a release for an
icon.

The 09-06 agenda is rebuilt. The version written at the morning wrap
predates everything after it, so it is marked superseded rather than
edited - an agenda that quietly grew new items reads as if they were
always there.

Two entries added to the standing pattern, and they are the same shape:
a file that said something false about itself. PaymentMethodLogos.tsx
claimed all twelve logos were HitPay kit cards (six were not, and one of
those six was mangled artwork live on checkout for five months);
reviewer.ts claimed it evaluates "an image or video frame" (nothing
extracts a frame, which is why a reel reached the API as an unreadable
400). In both cases the code was fine, no test could have caught it, and
being confidently wrong is what stopped anyone re-checking. Question
added: does this comment describe what the file IS, or what somebody
intended it to be?

npm run verify green: 476 files / 5319 tests.

iOS accounting for THIS commit: ZERO - CLAUDE.md and the SDUI contract.
No apps/ios-customer/**, no .swift, no SDUI spec, no bundled asset, no
migration, no route, no code.
